examples.name: Seawater Cooling Low Supply Alarm
examples.text: <memo>#NOTES#For the seawater cooling system, if a main circulation pump-related configuration is adopted, a low supply condition must be able to trigger an alarm to facilitate timely startup or changeover.
examples.text_zh: 海水冷却系统如果采用主循环泵相关配置，低供水情况要能报警，便于及时启动或切换。

examples.name: Low Supply Alarm Display Requirement
examples.text: <memo>#NOTES#When the seawater cooling system is configured with a main circulation pump, a low supply alarm function shall be provided. The alarm signal shall be capable of being displayed on the bridge or at the main control station so that operators can promptly start the standby pump or change over to the standby pump.

examples.text: <memo>#NOTES#The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data.
